PUNJAB LIQUOR LICENSE RULES, 1932
PUNJAB
LIQUOR LICENSE RULES, 1932
(Amendment of Rr. 26 and
31)
[Gazette
of Punjab, Extraordinary, 10th August, 2017]
No. SO(E&M)2-3/2011(P-III),
dated 26.7.2017.---In exercise of the powers conferred under
section 59 read with section 18 of the Punjab Excise Act, 1914 (I of 1914), the Excise Commissioner
Punjab is pleased to direct that in the Punjab Liquor License Rules, 1932, the
following further amendments shall be made:
In the Punjab Liquor License
Rules, 1932:
(1) in
rule 26, in clause (b), for the figure "Rs. 1,50,000/-", the words
"two hundred and twenty five thousand" shall be substituted; and
(2) for
rule 31, the following shall be substituted:
"31 The assessment of vend fee on the
retail sale of liquor shall be made at the following rates:
1.
All
brands of Pakistan made Foreign Liquor (PMFL).
Rs.
1600/- per bulk gallon or 6 quart size bottles of PMFL.
2.
Beer
made in Pakistan
Rs.
85/- per litre.
